scripts.dev: pnpm dev:infra && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev:apps
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @shipgate/jobs build && pnpm --filter @shipgate/database build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --enable-source-maps packages/jobs/dist/migration-cli.js up && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --enable-source-maps packages/database/dist/migration-cli.js up
scripts.db:status: pnpm --filter @shipgate/jobs build && pnpm --filter @shipgate/database build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --enable-source-maps packages/jobs/dist/migration-cli.js status && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --enable-source-maps packages/database/dist/migration-cli.js status
scripts.db:migrate:prod: node --enable-source-maps packages/jobs/dist/migration-cli.js up && node --enable-source-maps packages/database/dist/migration-cli.js up
